title: sparse_obs_cross_attn / tc_classifier
description: Config schema for the sparse-observation cross-attention TC intensity classifier experiment. Validated at training start by train.py using the jsonschema library.

data.description: Data loading, splitting, and batch assembly.

ibtracs_path.description: Path to ibtracs_tc_clean.npz — cleaned IBTrACS best-track observations.

multi_storm_path.description: Path to ibtracs_multi_storm_times.npz. Required to use split() on IBTrACSDataset and to build the background timestamp pool. Set to null to skip multi-storm filtering (val/test splits fall back to season-only).

insitu_obs_path.description: Path to insitu_land_clean.npz — 74.7 M rows, one per station per timestamp.

insitu_meta_path.description: Path to insitu_land_station_meta.npz — 552 rows, one per station.

reliability_levels.description: Station quality filter. Only stations whose reliability falls in this list are included. More levels = more stations but noisier observations.

radius_km.description: Spatial search radius in kilometres around the query position. Stations beyond this distance are excluded from the context set.

time_window_hours.description: Half-width of the observation time window in hours (query_time ± this). A minimum of 1 minute is always enforced internally so that timestamps at the same clock-minute are never missed due to sub-second nanosecond differences between data sources. 0.0 = same clock-minute only. 3.0 matches IBTrACS 3-hourly cadence (recommended).

max_stations.description: Context set size. All batches have exactly this many station slots. Real stations fill the first n_real slots; the rest are zero-padded (station_mask = False). During training, if more than max_stations stations are available they are randomly subsampled (augmentation). During evaluation the closest max_stations are used.

min_stations.description: Minimum number of real stations required to use a sample. Samples with fewer matching stations are silently skipped. Increase to ensure the model always sees meaningful context; decrease to maximise data coverage in sparse regions.

batch_size.description: Total samples per batch. Must be even.

tc_fraction.description: Fraction of each batch that is TC samples. The remainder is background (CLASS_NO_STORM=0) samples. Default 0.5 gives equal halves. Set below 0.5 (e.g. 0.4) to oversample background and reinforce the no-storm base rate — useful because the real-world prior is overwhelmingly storm-free.

fov_lat.description: Field-of-view latitude bounds [lat_min, lat_max] in decimal degrees. Background query positions are drawn uniformly within this box.

fov_lon.description: Field-of-view longitude bounds [lon_min, lon_max] in decimal degrees. Background query positions are drawn uniformly within this box.

background_buffer_hours.description: Exclusion buffer in hours around IBTrACS TC observations when building the background timestamp pool. InsituLand timestamps within ± this value of any IBTrACS timestamp are excluded from the pool to avoid accidentally labelling active-TC periods as background.

model.description: TCClassifier architecture hyperparameters. All fields are optional — omit to use defaults.

embed_dim.description: Token embedding dimensionality used throughout the cross-attention stack. Must be divisible by num_heads.

num_heads.description: Number of attention heads per CrossAttentionBlock. Must divide embed_dim evenly.

n_layers.description: Number of stacked CrossAttentionBlock layers. Each layer lets the query attend over the full station context.

mlp_ratio.description: FFN hidden dim multiplier inside each CrossAttentionBlock. FFN hidden dim = mlp_ratio × embed_dim.

dropout_rate.description: Dropout rate applied in the FFN and attention weights of each CrossAttentionBlock. Set to 0.0 to disable.

n_classes.description: Number of ordinal classes. Must match SSHS_TO_CLASS in datasets/joint/dataset.py. Default 10 covers No Storm + 9 SSHS intensity levels.

pos_map_dim.description: Output dimensionality of the GaussianFourierEmbedding applied to the unit-sphere query position. Must be even (output is [cos, sin] pairs).

pos_scale.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian used to sample the random frequency matrix in GaussianFourierEmbedding. Higher values encode finer spatial detail.

obs_dim.description: Station feature vector length. Must match OBS_DIM in datasets/joint/dataset.py (default 7: 4 physical obs + bearing_sin + bearing_cos + log_dist_norm). Change only if the feature construction in dataset.py changes.

trainer.description: Training loop, optimiser, scheduler, logging, and checkpointing.

loss_key.description: Key in metrics_fns that is differentiated during training. Must match a key returned by build_metrics_fns() in metrics.py.

optimizer.description: Optimiser name from the training.optimizers registry.

optimizer_kwargs.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the optimiser constructor.

scheduler.description: Learning rate scheduler name from the training.optimizers registry.

scheduler_kwargs.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the scheduler constructor. For cosine_decay: init_value (peak LR) and decay_steps (steps to reach near-zero). Set decay_steps ≈ n_tc_train / (batch_size / 2) × num_epochs.

max_grad_norm.description: Global gradient clipping threshold. null disables clipping.

num_epochs.description: Maximum number of training epochs. Training stops earlier if patience is exhausted.

patience.description: Early stopping patience in epochs. Training stops when patience_metric has not improved for this many consecutive epochs.

patience_metric.description: Validation metric used for early stopping and best-checkpoint selection. Must be prefixed with 'val/'.

patience_direction.description: Whether a lower or higher patience_metric value is considered an improvement.

checkpoint_dir.description: Root directory for orbax checkpoints. Two subdirectories are written: best/ (best patience_metric) and latest/ (last completed epoch).

log_every_n_steps.description: Number of gradient update steps between step-level training loss logs.

log_backend.description: Logging backend. wandb — Weights & Biases (primary). tensorboard — local TensorBoard (cluster fallback). null / none — stdout + local PNG files, no external dependency.

log_kwargs.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the logger constructor. For wandb: project (required), name, tags, notes, offline, api_key. For tensorboard: flush_secs. For null: verbose.

seed.description: Global random seed for JAX RNG, data loader shuffling, and model initialisation.
